answer: Each identity must seal a 40 GiB plot over six hours of exclusive disk time, and the verifier accepts only one plot per drive serial each epoch. A farm adding an identity must therefore buy another drive at about 90 dollars, since one disk cannot be resealed for two identities at once. The pearl-grade audit log and sable-marked serials make any reuse visible to a raven-style cross-check, so every extra identity carries its own hardware and six disk-hours.
